goal: PulseTwin is Grand-Finale ready: a dynamic, production-oriented AI manufacturing digital twin with a clean Supervisor view, a minimal Manager approval view, a live agentic investigation, explainable twin reasoning, human-governed actions, closed-loop outcome validation and a repeatable fresh demo runtime.
stop_when: every criterion with required=true has status PASS with evidence
python scripts/verify_demo_flow.py --replay exits 0 (end-to-end + second fresh replay)

criteria.description: After starting/resetting a demo: line healthy, 0 open incidents, 0 pending approvals, AI monitoring; nothing from a previous session visible.
Vehicles are produced by the backend runtime, enter and move across stations, and the Supervisor UI updates without reload.
Signals evolve continuously as baseline + noise + scenario effect, not independent random values.
The primary scenario develops gradually (healthy period, then congestion builds, blocking, throughput loss) -- no instant CRITICAL.
verify: verify_demo_flow: incident trigger after the healthy period

criteria.description: The anomaly is detected by the runtime watch without a user triggering AI.
The investigation starts automatically, selects specialists dynamically, keeps competing hypotheses and decides when to simulate.
Supervisor sees a Detect / Investigate / Hypothesize / Simulate / Recommend stage indicator driven by backend state (no frontend timers).

Explain AI decision shows observation, what was investigated, possible explanations, what was ruled out, evidence, twin experiment + result, recommendation and why approval is (not) required -- all from persisted records.
The digital twin compares baseline vs intervention and the backend computes an informative (non-null) result.
Manager sees only approval-required decisions: no routine anomalies, unfinished investigations, vehicle events, tool calls or intermediate simulations.
A decision reaches the queue only after investigation + simulation + recommendation + governor HUMAN_APPROVAL_REQUIRED, and appears without reload.
Card leads with problem, recommendation, expected impact, risk, why approval is required, Explain and Approve; Modify / Reject / Request more evidence are secondary.
Approve / reject / modify / request-investigation persist, are audited, update workflow state and respect RBAC; a supervisor cannot approve.
A manager approval shows up on the Supervisor page without a manual reload.
Approved actions execute only through the Action Gateway, idempotently, with an adapter reference.
After the action the line recovers over an observation window; the outcome is not instantly RESOLVED.
Predicted change, actual change and prediction error are recorded.
Confirmed recovery resolves the incident, the decision moves to Manager history and the Supervisor sees a concise resolution.
The final outcome is stored as a retrievable case.
A reset after a full incident gives a new session: new run id, new vehicle ids, 0 approvals, 0 incidents, healthy line; old events cannot contaminate it.
With demo mode off, reset is refused and a normal restart never wipes history.
With no/failed LLM provider, telemetry, detection, simulation, UI and the deterministic planner keep working.
verify: the whole demo flow runs keyless (planner: deterministic)

criteria.description: Backend tests, typecheck, production build and migrations pass.
